monetary_cost_scope.note: Quota unit is not a USD price; no paid API/data/model invocation performed in this source review.

sources.title: YouTube Data API Overview
sources.access_scope: Before you start; resources; quota usage; partial resources
sources.supporting_claim: Google account, Cloud project, API enablement and credentials are setup steps; public list and authorized list are distinct; part/fields reduce returned data.
sources.conflict_or_uncertainty: Setup documented; no project console or successful API call verified. Old illustrative resource examples are not current schema guarantees.

sources.title: Quota Calculator
sources.access_scope: Quota allocation paragraphs and per-method table
sources.supporting_claim: Search Queries: 1 unit/call, default 100/day; Video Uploads: separate 100/day; other listed methods share 10,000/day. Reset midnight Pacific. Each page costs separately.
sources.conflict_or_uncertainty: Page Summary retains older upload-cost prose. Current body/table used. No USD price inferred; actual project quota unverified.

sources.title: Search: list
sources.supporting_claim: Search has its own 1-unit bucket. Max 50/page. Date filters and q are optional; region means viewability and language means relevance. Channel video search without specified owner filters is limited to 500. Indexing delays/incomplete date-sorted results are documented; use uploads playlist for recent channel uploads.
sources.conflict_or_uncertainty: No corpus completeness or strict Korean-language guarantee. short is under four minutes, not a Shorts selector. No live call made.

sources.title: Videos: list
sources.supporting_claim: 1 unit; chart mostPopular and region/category selection; ID requests do not support maxResults or pageToken. Owner-only parts can cause permission errors.
sources.conflict_or_uncertainty: Method's generic popularity description requires revision history context. Exact effective chart size untested.

sources.title: Videos
sources.supporting_claim: Public metadata/statistics and caption-presence flag are documented. Public view definition changes on 2026-08-24. Dislikes and fileDetails are owner-restricted. Examined schema has no general isShort field.
sources.conflict_or_uncertainty: Availability is conditional. No raw audiovisual data or public universal transcript endpoint established; view-count historical revision behavior unknown.

sources.title: Channels: list
sources.supporting_claim: Channel metadata/contentDetails can be requested for channel identifiers/handles; method cost is 1 unit.
sources.conflict_or_uncertainty: Requested project's ability to access channel records untested.

sources.title: Channels
sources.supporting_claim: Uploads playlist ID identifies the channel's uploaded-video list. Subscriber count is rounded to three significant figures. Public view definition names 2026-08-24.
sources.conflict_or_uncertainty: Channel metadata does not establish language representativeness or access to owner-only analytics.

sources.title: PlaylistItems: list
sources.access_scope: Method quota and all request parameters
sources.supporting_claim: 1 unit/page, maximum 50/page; playlist ID plus snippet/contentDetails yields uploaded-video list; no publishedAfter/Before parameter listed.
sources.conflict_or_uncertainty: Actual number of pages and returned/public videos unverified.

sources.title: PlaylistItems
sources.supporting_claim: snippet.publishedAt is time added to the playlist; contentDetails.videoPublishedAt is time the video was published.
sources.conflict_or_uncertainty: Do not substitute playlist insertion time for video publication or past availability.

sources.title: CommentThreads: list
sources.access_scope: Quota; filters; order; searchTerms; textFormat; errors
sources.supporting_claim: 1 unit/page, maximum 100/page, order time/relevance; public published threads; commentsDisabled and permission/not-found errors documented.
sources.conflict_or_uncertainty: No date-window request parameter. SearchTerms results are query-selected; no guarantee of all public/removed comments.

sources.title: CommentThreads
sources.supporting_claim: Thread responses need not include all replies. totalReplyCount plus comments.list(parentId) supports separate reply retrieval.
sources.conflict_or_uncertainty: Response completeness can change with moderation/deletion; a captured reply subset is not the whole thread.

sources.title: Comments: list
sources.supporting_claim: 1 unit/page; maximum 100/page; parentId retrieves replies to top-level comments; plainText/HTML available.
sources.conflict_or_uncertainty: No live call; later nested-reply support must be rechecked if API changes.

sources.title: Comments
sources.supporting_claim: textDisplay plain text may differ from original. textOriginal is returned only to the authenticated comment author; authorChannelId is available only if present. Parent, publication and update fields support context.
sources.conflict_or_uncertainty: Data availability does not authorize user-identifier harvesting; IDs may be absent. No comment originals collected.

sources.title: Captions: list
sources.supporting_claim: 50 units; OAuth scopes required; response is track metadata, not caption text; insufficient permissions can cause 403.
sources.conflict_or_uncertainty: Do not assume all third-party public video tracks can be listed with a key or arbitrary OAuth.

sources.title: Captions: download
sources.access_scope: Method introduction; quota; authorization; format options
sources.supporting_claim: 200 units; OAuth and video-edit permission required for downloading a caption track.
sources.conflict_or_uncertainty: Currently supplied personal-developer context does not establish edit permission for third-party videos.

sources.title: View video transcripts
sources.supporting_claim: Videos with captions offer Show transcript and caption-line navigation in the public viewing UI.
sources.conflict_or_uncertainty: Read only official help; no individual-video UI tested. UI access is not an API or permission for bulk extraction.

sources.title: Understand three-minute YouTube Shorts
sources.access_scope: Eligibility for three-minute Shorts; Standard/Official Artist channel distinctions
sources.supporting_claim: Standard square/vertical videos uploaded on/after 2024-10-15 up to three minutes are categorized as Shorts; Artist channel cutoff differs at 2025-12-08.
sources.conflict_or_uncertainty: Video duration alone is insufficient for historical or universal Shorts labeling.

sources.title: Revision History
sources.supporting_claim: Shorts counting changed 2025-03-31; mostPopular changed to Music/Movies/Gaming charts 2025-07-21; granular quota transition announced 2026-06-01; all-format view changes documented under 2026-08-27.
sources.conflict_or_uncertainty: The 2026-08-27 entry date differs from resource definitions' 2026-08-24 effective date. Do not collapse these dates.

sources.title: Quota and Compliance Audits
sources.access_scope: Body quota allocation; audit and extension process
sources.supporting_claim: Current body states separate 100 search/100 upload defaults plus 10,000 other units. Additional quota requires a compliance audit.
sources.conflict_or_uncertainty: Summary still describes only 10,000/day. No paid overage price or guaranteed approval/turnaround established.

sources.title: YouTube API Services - Developer Policies
sources.supporting_claim: Restricts undocumented services, audiovisual copies, aggregation and derived data; ordinary non-authorized data has refresh/delete limits; III.L confines additional analysis/storage policies to accepted audited analytics developers.
sources.conflict_or_uncertainty: This project's exact text-analysis and cross-channel linkage use case has no confirmed approval. Documentary review is not legal advice or YouTube authorization.

sources.title: Additional policies for derived metrics and data storage
sources.access_scope: Intro; content categorization; viewer sentiment; Data Storage
sources.supporting_claim: After relevant amendment/use-case acceptance, examples include content tagging and NLP comment analysis; accepted statistics/derived metrics may be stored up to 36 months; text fields retain 30-day refresh/delete rule.
sources.conflict_or_uncertainty: General personal API access does not establish this exception. Memorized raw snapshots are not granted permanent retention by this page.

sources.title: Complying with YouTube's Developer Policies
sources.access_scope: Respect user privacy; metrics; acceptable metrics; compliance audit instruction
sources.supporting_claim: Addresses non-consensual identifying-data harvesting, mixed-platform engagement, some simple arithmetic examples and applying for audit when uncertain.
sources.conflict_or_uncertainty: Guide examples and newer amendment must be interpreted together with policy body; no universal permission to profile authors or derive research tags inferred.

sources.title: YouTube Research - How It Works
sources.supporting_claim: Academic institution affiliation and institutional application email; qualifying students/staff/faculty; Korea included; scaled access to public global video metadata through Data API.
sources.conflict_or_uncertainty: Personal development alone does not establish eligibility. Expanded arbitrary captions or raw-video access not promised.

sources.title: YouTube Research - Policies
sources.access_scope: Who can apply; general requirements; publication
sources.supporting_claim: Institution affiliation, research goal/publication intent and further conditions apply; program participants also follow relevant YouTube/API terms.
sources.conflict_or_uncertainty: Only policy summary page read; linked full researcher terms not reviewed. No application or admission made.

sources.title: YouTube API Services Terms of Service
sources.access_scope: Definitions; Agreement precedence; registration; relevant fee searches
sources.supporting_claim: Defines API Data and Agreement; Terms have precedence on contradiction. Inspected page does not supply a current per-call USD tariff.
sources.conflict_or_uncertainty: This is a limited access/cost review, not a complete legal analysis; lack of price table is not a contractual guarantee of future free use.

sources.title: YouTube Researcher Program
sources.access_scope: About the program; How it works; Program policies
sources.supporting_claim: Program advertises scaled public-data access for eligible researchers and links eligibility and process documents.
sources.conflict_or_uncertainty: Marketing access statement does not establish current user's qualification or extra media rights.
